# omni_user_attributes (Data Source)

Lists every user attribute definition on the instance.

Useful for checking that a target instance has the attributes a configuration expects before applying it, since definitions cannot be created through the API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_system` (Boolean) Whether to include Omni's built-in attributes. Defaults to `false`, since those are populated by the platform and are not usable for tenant scoping.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (Map of String) Reference name to display label, for the matching attributes.
- `names` (List of String) Reference names of the matching attributes.
